text: The autonomous baggage tractor (green track) is stopped at the red X indicating a personnel_clearance safety violation on the apron taxi lane near B20, immediately adjacent to the active jet-blast zones (orange dashed boxes) of the navy aircraft parked at A7 and A8. This creates an imminent hazard of jet-blast injury, debris strike, and collision due to loss of required separation between the autonomous vehicle/personnel and the aircraft.
